newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-WORLD CUP HOLDERS SRI LANKA TO ADVERTISE FOR NEW COACH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WORLD CUP HOLDERS SRI LANKA TO ADVERTISE FOR NEW COACH.

text.p: World Cup holders Sri Lanka are to
advertise for a coach to replace former Australian test player
Dav Whatmore who is quitting to join English county side
Lancashire when his contract expires in May next year.
"We will advertise locally and internationally for someone
to coach the World Cup champions," Upali Dharmadasa, president
of Sri Lanka's cricket board, said on Wednesday.

after the board failed in their bid to enlist two former test
captains, Allan Border and Ian Botham.
